body:
KKR to acquire Gen II Fund Services from Hg, General Atlantic and other minority investors through a core private equity strategy for a total enterprise value of $5.1B.Gen II is a private-capital fund administrator and provides fund administration, tax, compliance, treasury, and technology-enabled services to more than 275 investment managers representing over $2T in private-fund capital.It has expanded U.S. and European operations and broadened its services since Hg and General Atlantic invested in the company in 2020.KKR said Gen II has quadrupled revenue and EBITDA over that period through organic growth and four strategic acquisitions. Gen II CEO and co-founder Steven Millner will continue to lead the company. KKR plans to support Gen II’s global expansion and invest in technology and AI capabilities.The transaction is expected to close in 2027.
